description: Pauses or resumes one collector channel. Pausing keeps the channel, its credential and its configuration: batches the collector sends while paused are accepted and discarded, so nothing is stored or measured and the collector does not retry in a loop. Resuming stores the next batch again. The input central changes only a channel of the same owner, including one whose device was already deleted.

collector.description: alloy, telegraf, opentelemetry, ncpa, collectd or snmp.
